prompts.velvet_curtain_screen: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent native construction sprite kit for a top-down 2D theater puzzle game. Draw EXACTLY THREE isolated components, widely separated on a transparent 1536x1024 canvas, no lettering, no grid, no checker texture. Style reference: Panty & Stocking with Garterbelt graphic sensibility applied to theater environment: very thick crisp near-black navy outer lines, angular long straight edges and wedges, flat cel shading, 2-3 tones per material. Rich crimson burgundy velvet, ivory and warm gold rigid header, darkplum shadow. Component A upper left: one very long perfectly horizontal repeating theater curtain SCREEN section WITHOUT END POSTS, long straight golden-ivory top header, several angular crimson hanging pleats with trapezoidal hem, shallow top-down plane and short front drop; horizontal occupancy much larger than height. The body must run completely straight left-to-right, with no hanging swag arcs and no end caps. Component B upper right, separated from A by transparent gutter: one long perfectly VERTICAL north-to-south thin curtain-screen run, as seen from above, narrow gold ivory raised header along the vertical axis with burgundy folded velvet to the right side. Same floor projection as A, directional orientation truly vertical, not a front-facing horizontal curtain. No end posts. Component C lower left: one isolated ivory and gold squared joint/end post with a small diamond finial, short burgundy side inset, polygonal base. Keep C upright in the same camera as A, no extra props. Use clean geometrical cutouts, no rounded inflated forms, no gradients or painterly texture, no 3D rendering. No people, stage floor, wall, architecture, text, labels, drop-shadow backdrop or darkground. Maintain large transparent gutters between the three components. They will be mechanically sliced into a modular connected screen; connected carrier ends must have simple straight edges. Camera floor axes exactly horizontal/vertical, no isometric diamond.
